# Suggested GitHub Labels

Create these labels for consistent triage:

| Label | Color | Purpose |
|-------|-------|---------|
| `bug` | `#d73a4a` | Defect |
| `enhancement` | `#a2eeef` | Feature request |
| `documentation` | `#0075ca` | Docs |
| `security` | `#ee0701` | Security-sensitive |
| `performance` | `#fbca04` | Perf work |
| `good first issue` | `#7057ff` | New contributor friendly |
| `phase-investigation` | `#0e8a16` | Investigation engine |
| `phase-assistant` | `#5319e7` | AI assistant |
| `needs-triage` | `#ededed` | Unreviewed |

## Milestones (examples)

- `v1.0.0` — Production launch (this release)
- `v1.1.0` — Auth & multi-user workspaces (future)
- `v1.2.0` — Distributed rate limiting / Redis (future)
